name: comment-verdict-chrome-plugin
description: A Chrome extension built with Plasmo, React, and Manifest V3
author: Your Name

scripts.build:prod: node scripts/swap-portal-sync.js prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production COMMENT_VERDICT_DEBUG=0 plasmo build --tag=prod --target=chrome-mv3 && node scripts/swap-portal-sync.js dev
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/swap-portal-sync.js dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development COMMENT_VERDICT_DEBUG=1 plasmo build --tag=dev --target=chrome-mv3
scripts.package:prod: node scripts/swap-portal-sync.js prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production COMMENT_VERDICT_DEBUG=0 plasmo build --tag=prod --zip && node scripts/swap-portal-sync.js dev
